user.title: Tessera Claude
user.description: Claude sessions, their questions and the account's limits for Tessera screens. Everything here is optional: a player for the announcement of a new question (chime and spoken text, or the chime alone) through Chime TTS, and whether a permission prompt on the PC is announced.

data.chime: Chime (Chime TTS preset, empty for none)
data.tts: Speech engine (tts entity, empty for Chime TTS's default)

data.chime: Chime (Chime TTS preset, empty for none)
data.tts: Speech engine (tts entity, empty for Chime TTS's default)
data.allowed_users: Users allowed to call the services and the API (empty: everyone; administrators and calls without a user always pass)

get_overview.name: Get overview
get_overview.description: Every Claude session with its state, context and open questions, and the account's limits.

get_question.name: Get question
get_question.description: One open question by its handle: its parts and options, with their ids.

get_hint.name: Get hint
get_hint.description: What a session waits for on the PC.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: Answers an open question. Exactly one answer takes effect; the response says whether this one did.

rev.name: Revision
rev.description: The rev get_question returned, so a stale question is not answered.

get_background.name: Get background tasks
get_background.description: The background tasks of the running sessions, newest first, with their progress and note where a task reports one.

set_notify.name: Set announcement
set_notify.description: How a new question or hint is announced: speech (chime and spoken text), tone (the chime alone) or nothing. The display's bus events stay on.
